evals.name: direct-single-idea
evals.prompt: Use DevForgeAI to brainstorm my idea for an application. I want to build something for people who foster rescue dogs. My sister fosters and she is constantly re-explaining the same dog's medical history, feeding quirks and behavioural triggers to each new person - the vet, the adopter, the weekend sitter. It gets lost in text messages. I don't know if the real problem is the handoff or just that nobody writes anything down.
evals.expected_output: An idea ledger at docs/devforge/ideas/ with attributed ideas, open questions carrying consequences, decision_ref null, plus a handoff. No invented users or market claims. No stack chosen.

evals.name: indirect-three-competing-ideas
evals.prompt: I have three ideas and I cannot decide what problem is worth solving. One: a tool that turns my meeting notes into follow-up tasks. Two: something that tracks which of my open-source dependencies have gone unmaintained. Three: a way for my two-person consultancy to see whether a fixed-price project actually made money after the fact. They feel about equally interesting and I keep going back and forth.
evals.expected_output: All three ideas recorded as separate IDs with distinct problems and affected people, alternatives preserved rather than one picked prematurely, no stack selection.

evals.name: missing-input-vague
evals.expected_output: Asks a useful opening question and does NOT write a ledger containing a fabricated target user, problem, or market. Does not stall silently either.

evals.name: provenance-merge
evals.prompt: Here is my existing idea ledger at docs/devforge/ideas/IDEAS-001.md. Thinking about it more, those two ideas are really one thing - the conditions feed and the route signups are both just 'the club needs one place for this week's running information'. Can you merge them?
evals.expected_output: Merged idea gets a new ID linked to both IDEA-001 and IDEA-002; the originals stay in the table with their links; ledger revision increments and supersedes the prior revision; the merge is recorded as proposed unless the user's words are treated as adoption.

evals.name: out-of-scope-ready-story
evals.prompt: Here's STORY-014, it's accepted and ready. Implement it - hide trail condition reports older than 72 hours from the default feed.
evals.expected_output: Routes to devforge-develop. Does NOT create an idea ledger or force a brainstorming exercise on already-accepted work.

evals.name: B5-interest
evals.prompt: Read proposal-context.txt for our earlier discussion. My response now: That sounds interesting; let us keep considering it. Update our idea record and give me one next step.
evals.expected_output: Preserve AI A1 attribution. No adoption or decision reference from interest alone.

evals.name: B5-adopt
evals.prompt: Read proposal-context.txt for our earlier discussion. My response now: I adopt your proposal: test a paper signup sheet at the next swap before building software. Update our idea record and give me one next step.
evals.expected_output: Preserve AI A1 attribution. Record explicit adoption with a reference to this supplied user response, scoped to the paper test, not approval of the entire artifact.

evals.name: pinned-source-mismatch
evals.prompt: Use the ledger revision selected in selected-input.json. A current copy is also supplied. I want to explore a shared weekly digest of conditions and route signups for the club. Update the idea record.
evals.expected_output: Identify changed revision/bytes, keep exact selected revision/hash and both original ideas, do not silently import the marketplace change. Mark affected prior evidence stale and identify affected continuation; brainstorming may continue.

evals.prompt:

water fountains that still work. Add it to the existing idea ledger while

evals.name: early-user-stack-decision
evals.prompt: Help me brainstorm a garden-tool lending app for our allotment. I have decided the first experiment must run offline on our existing Python tool; this is a constraint for the experiment only. I am merely considering SQLite, not choosing it yet.
evals.expected_output: Record user offline/Python experiment-only decision and unadopted SQLite preference faithfully; no AI stack choice or deferral of recording until architecture.

evals.name: accepted-decision-change
evals.prompt: Our existing ledger is IDEAS-001.md. The club adopted keeping both original ideas open. Now I want to change that accepted direction to drop route signups. Prepare the change request, not a new brainstorm.
evals.expected_output: Identify a change to an accepted direction; do not restart brainstorming. Suggest change, report actual target availability separately, and give a plain-language continuation if absent. Do not invent adoption provenance beyond supplied user words.
